purpose: Pre-launch traffic feasibility only, not performance-cohort admission
window: Trailing 30 days ending at raw/collection-window.json as_of
head_policy: Count each distinct current PR head SHA once only if an exact-head CI workflow pull_request run was observed in the window. Historical superseded heads retained in raw Actions inputs but not counted in this conservative matched-head estimate.
file_policy: Read complete paginated PR file inventory. Classify execution-change candidates if diff includes .rkt/.rktl/.scrbl outside docs/artifacts/reports, scripts/ except .md, or .github/workflows or .github/actions. Exempt docs-only only when every path is markdown/text under docs/reports/wiki-src or root README/CHANGELOG/LICENSE. Other changes unknown and not counted. Renames consider old and new path. Deletions remain execution changes. This is a traffic heuristic, NOT the trusted W1 exemption allowlist.
truthfulness: Historical green runs may mask failure (BUG-0073); all historical heads remain UNVERIFIED for clean cohort eligibility. Source identity, full artifact completeness, required-claim comparability and independent exclusions must be verified later. No historical run counts toward R2/R4.
projection: Conditional planning estimate only: 40 / observed execution-change candidate heads * 30 calendar days; also report sensitivity at 50% and 25% admission. Zero validated eligible heads means no guaranteed duration. Serial future cohort windows can lengthen elapsed time.
future_policy: R2 >=20 distinct genuine post-W4 heads; final >=20 disjoint post-W6 heads, disjoint from historical samples; no docs-only/exempt heads, manufactured PRs or repeated attempts for uniqueness. First-attempt completions, retain failures/cancellations; missing/incomplete/censored records block closure. Pre-register references before viewing candidate results.
observation: Check every 7 calendar days while cohort open; at 30 days stop automated retries and request coordinator resumption/amendment. No deadline waives thresholds. Dates start from each actual activation/decision merge, not this preflight.
